task.title: [M7] Costume and visual-outfit compatibility boundaries
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M7
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M7-03
**Implementation status:** Implemented; independent QA_PASS. Accepted transition is recorded by the live Kaneo column.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex `aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn`; independent configured reviewer `/root/rsf34_qa`.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.1–2.2, 3.2, 6/M7
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Keep optional clothing composition separate from the base asset compiler.

**Scope:** Variant compatibility and separate optional clothing-composition adapter contract over approved supplied art.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Represent alternate body styles/costume/animation variants with explicit target/action compatibility rather than gameplay job substitution.
- [x] Any optional clothing adapter stays separate from generic compiler and consumes operator-approved artwork with exact assignment provenance.
- [x] No automatic garment segmentation/redraw, invisible fallback or unchanged original outfit counts as newly authored clothing coverage.
- [x] Report unsupported variant/equipment combinations and retain scoped/full, review and native status distinctions.

## Verification

Synthetic variant/mismatch/retained-classic-art cases; inspect optional adapter boundary and operator approval requirements.

Actual commands, exit statuses, source identities, environment and NOT_RUN limits are recorded in docs/verification/rsf-34/commands.json, environment.json, REPORT.md and QA_REPORT.md. The independent reviewer reproduced applicable checks. No artistic approval or new native run is claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-33 (M7-02; task ID ohmigbqn0escc46dkopt2h0c)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No mandatory clothing subsystem, AI art generation or automatic art acceptance.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code: optional core/appearance.py; compatible registry v1 cosmetic_pairings extension; registry load identity fix; synthetic/private tests and schema checker. Exact six changed implementation paths and hashes: docs/verification/rsf-34/implementation-manifest.json (SHA-256 9510cfb09211fbe6ab5711d85fe8654d3bdcbbd45a34e0099c6e696d1efbc7c2).
- Checks (all exit 0): focused 79 (35 new), public 618, private 52 run / 51 PASS / one legacy skip, Rust parity 11 plus three actual source comparisons, 12 schema checkers; isolated distribution 618 run / 606 PASS / 12 optional Rust-tool skips. Four repeated synthetic modes byte-identical: determinism SHA-256 68ae25c64b6a6894245d7bb3916777bbb856497a46481d12fc7d01327e856be9.
- Scoped structural compatibility passes. Genetic/Jack 104 slots supported; Genetic/shield 96/104, exact Pickup mismatch retained. Existing shield parent is novice-male-body-v1; no Dragon Knight body is enrolled. Separate head rehosting requires explicit binding. New cosmetic compilation/native remain UNVERIFIED; export_ready=false. Python 3.14 tested; 3.12/3.13 unavailable. No UI/native changes; browser/GPU NOT_RUN. M7 remains open for RSF-35.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

**QA_PASS**, separate configured forge_qa_reviewer `/root/rsf34_qa`. Independently executed focused, full public, private, Rust, schema, reproduction, fresh alpha/frame/hash/pool probes and installed-distribution checks; all passed. No findings, source edits, Kaneo writes or ownership changes by reviewer. Original logs/probe and exact commands: docs/verification/rsf-34/QA_REPORT.md and independent-qa/. Verified QA comment ww1u7xe6w8204olfqbavgh0i. Human artwork approval remains separate. Coordinator may perform authorized objective acceptance after this verdict.
